nguon: 💬 Giao tiếp · Tình huống khẩn · bài tự soạn
kind: Hội thoại hỏi đường khi bị lạc
L: Excuse me, I think I'm lost. Could you help me?
Sure. Where are you trying to go?
The train station. My phone's dead, so I can't use the map.
No worries. It's about ten minutes on foot.
Go straight down this road, then turn left at the traffic lights.
Straight, then left at the lights. Got it.
You'll see a big park on your right. The station is just past it.
Thank you so much. You're a lifesaver!
Anytime. Be careful crossing the road, it's busy.

exq.q: Why can't Amy use the map?
w: She left her phone at home
exq.why: “My phone's dead” = điện thoại hết pin.

exq.q: How long does it take to walk to the station?
exq.why: “about ten minutes on foot” = đi bộ khoảng mười phút.

exq.q: Where does Amy need to turn left?
exq.why: “turn left at the traffic lights” = rẽ trái ở đèn giao thông.

exq.q: What will Amy see on her right?
exq.why: “a big park on your right” = một công viên lớn bên tay phải.
